usedFor: Salesforce holds contacts and Givebutter holds your fundraising, so “Update Contact” can run “Create a Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Update Contact” in Salesforce, then “Create a Contact” in Givebutter
bestTemplate.why: A changed Salesforce contact is created in Givebutter, so donor records start from your CRM details.

watchOut: “Update Contact” is polling and fires on every edit, so “Create a Contact” can add the same person twice.
